title: Life Manager — Smart Excel System
description: Connected Arabic workbook unifying goals, habits, budget, savings, balance, gratitude, and settings in a single visual management system with validated inputs and automated summaries.
problem: How can personal goals, habits and budgets be tracked in one connected workbook?
approach: Organized an Arabic Excel system around validated inputs and linked summaries for goals, savings and everyday tracking.
outcome: A downloadable workbook with a dashboard and coordinated tracking sheets.
limitations: A personal-productivity demonstration. Financial entries and outcomes depend on the user’s own inputs.
